prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs.
Required API: pub fn dependency_ready(items: &[Vec<&str>], completed: &[&str]) -> Option<Vec<String>>
Behavior: Each item is name followed by zero or more dependency names. Names match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Reject duplicate names, unknown dependencies, and cycles. Return code-point-lexicographically sorted names whose dependencies are all completed, excluding completed items.
Visible example: items api->db, db, ui->api with completed [db] returns [api].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::{HashMap,HashSet};fn dk(s:&str)->bool{let b=s.as_bytes();!b.is_empty()&&b[0].is_ascii_lowercase()&&!s.starts_with("__")&&b.iter().all(|x|x.is_ascii_lowercase()||x.is_ascii_digit()||*x==b'-')&&!s.starts_with('-')&&!s.ends_with('-')&&!s.contains("--")}pub fn dependency_ready(a:&[Vec<&str>],c:&[&str])->Option<Vec<String>>{let mut d=HashMap::new();for x in a{if x.is_empty()||x.iter().any(|y|!dk(y))||d.insert(x[0],&x[1..]).is_some(){return None}}if d.values().flat_map(|x|x.iter()).any(|x|!d.contains_key(x)){return None}let mut rem:HashSet<&str>=d.keys().copied().collect();while !rem.is_empty(){let ready:Vec<_>=rem.iter().copied().filter(|n|d[n].iter().all(|x|!rem.contains(x))).collect();if ready.is_empty(){return None}for n in ready{rem.remove(n);}}let z:HashSet<_>=c.iter().copied().collect();let mut o:Vec<_>=d.iter().filter(|(n,v)|!z.contains(**n)&&v.iter().all(|x|z.contains(x))).map(|(n,_)|n.to_string()).collect();o.sort();Some(o)}
